items.description: Report states short-horizon spotEMA propagation conditionally ('If') and does not establish it as an observed prior state; the precondition is encoded as a scenario condition.
Report gives the spotEMA weight as 10% (should be 0%) but no numeric definition of the EMA blend operands or their units for a full arithmetic relation.

Report does not state the concrete tickDeltaLiquidation value or the exact currentTick/twapTick values, so the numeric gate comparison cannot be bound; the outcome flip is represented as a grounded Boolean relation.
Report does not state who triggers twapEMA() or any authorization condition for the TWAP computation.
